`my $s = "aXbXc"; $s =~ /X/g; $s = $s; print pos($s) // "undef", "\n";` -- perl 2, PCL undef.  perl's sv_setsv(dsv, ssv) returns at once when dsv == ssv, so no magic is touched and pos survives; PCL's assignment path (box-set) clears pos on every store.  Fix shape: box-set (or the scalar-assign emission) skips the store and the pos clear when the source IS the destination box.  Guard row: Pl/t/elem-pos-01.t (perl-compared).
